% 17.02.2023 1. Petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 438 Cr.P.C. for seeking anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 748/2020 under Sections 498A/406 IPC registered at Police Station Vasant Kunj (South).
2. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is mother-in-law and there are no specific allegations against her.

It is further submitted that petitioner was granted interim protection on 15.09.2022 and since then, she has been joining the investigation and nothing is to be recovered from her and there are no allegations against the petitioner with regard to the tempering of evidence and threatening the witnesses.
It is further submitted that there are no allegations of entrustment of articles by the complainant 3.
On the other hand, learned APP for the State argues on the line of status report.
She further submits that there are specific allegations against the petitioner and recovery is yet to be effected from the petitioner.

4. The Investigating Officer, namely, SI Ranbir is present in Court and he submits that petitioner has joined the investigation on five occasions and further states that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not required.

sentences.text:
Keeping in view the facts and circumstances, the petition is allowed and in the event of arrest, the petitioner be released on bail subject to his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.20,000/-
with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/Investigating Officer/SHO of the concerned Police Station.
However, petitioner shall join the investigation as and when required by the Investigating Officer.
6. The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
